about.title: Hi, I'm Carlos.
about.body:
I'm a product designer who builds what he designs. I take ideas from a sketch to a shipped app: research, flows, UI, and then the Swift, Next.js and Supabase to make it real.

Every world on this map is a product I designed and shipped. The bricks are the story, the billboards are the work, and the pipes are the decisions I had to make.

Pick 1 PRODUCT DESIGNER on the title screen for the design story, or 2 PRODUCT BUILDER to see more of how it was built.

contact.letter:
Thank you for playing!

If you made it to the castle, we should talk. I'm looking for a team where design and building happen in the same room.

Send me a note and tell me what you're working on.
